kind: Inspection of the customer account screens against docs/revamp/specs/wave6-quality.md, with a failing test for each defect found and its fix. No gap status is changed here. No language work.
findingsNote: No row in docs/qa/current-plan-gaps/findings.json is changed. GAP-050 (busy actions) evidence is the Q-06 list below; the Conductor decides its status.
status: Built on branch revamp/customer over main 7187a9d. CI on the exact pushed head is the verifier; see the pull request for its result.
defectsProvedAndFixed: notifications-form.tsx, Q-05 offline: a dropped request showed the browser's own words ("Failed to fetch"). Now: "Your choices were not saved. Check your connection, then try again." The choices stay on screen. Test failed first.
notifications-form.tsx, Q-05 unavailable: a 503 that was an HTML error page showed the parser's words ("Unexpected token '<'..."). Now the plain not-saved line. Test failed first.
notifications-form.tsx, Q-05 429: showed whatever text the server sent. Now "The request limit was reached. Try again later." (the same line the guided draft already used). Test failed first.

notifications-form.tsx, Q-06: the form had no aria-busy while a save ran (the button was already disabled and a double click already sent one request). aria-busy added. Test failed first on that attribute only.
customer-workspace-leave.tsx, Q-05 429: showed "Leaving was not confirmed. Try the same request again." which invites an immediate retry. Now the limit line. Test failed first.
customer-workspace-invitation.tsx, Q-05 429: same pattern ("Retry this invitation with the same request."). Now the limit line. Test failed first.

drafts/guided-request.tsx: persist() now re-checks the editor session after reading the answer as well, per the Conductor's instruction. Defensive only: Back, Discard, Send and Save draft are disabled during a save, so no screen path exists to prove it with a failing test; this is said plainly here and in the pull request.

notifications-form.tsx, Codex P2 on PR 285 (verified): a 200 whose body could not be read became an empty answer, took the success branch and announced that email was on or off without confirmation. Now only an explicit saved:true counts; an unreadable body or one with no saved flag shows the not-saved line, announces nothing and leaves the saved state as it was. Two cases (unreadable body, no saved flag) failed first.
checkedNoDefect: customer-workspace-invitation.tsx, Q-05 offline: keeps the code and says joining was not confirmed, with no machine words (test passed on first run).
Q-02 and Q-03 on the changed states (offline and limit lines of the email choices form): no sideways scroll and axe wcag2a/wcag2aa/wcag21aa/wcag22aa clean at 320 and 390 (passed on first run).
Q-06 double click on the email choices form sends one request (passed; only aria-busy was missing).
foundNotFixed: Q-05 429: these screens give no own line for a rate limit and show the general not-confirmed or failed words instead: assigned-missions.tsx, customer-workspace-team.tsx, customer-workspaces.tsx, saved-missions.tsx, missions/saved-commercial-report.tsx, missions/specification-confirmation.tsx, missions/decision-history.tsx, service-requests/service-request-new.tsx, requests/request-detail.tsx. Five of them share savedMissionRead (apps/web/app/account/saved-missions.tsx), which maps every other status to 'failed'; a single 'limit' reason there plus the limit line in each catch is the likely fix. Found by reading, not yet proved by a failing test, so not changed in this PR. Proposed as the next slice.

Q-01 (keyboard, focus to heading, error summary) and Q-04 (right to left): not swept in this slice beyond what existing specs already cover (guided request, saved commercial report and customer workspace specs press Tab and check focus; rooms and move views set dir from the content language). No new finding and no new test.
Q-08 performance numbers: not recorded in this slice (needs a production build with CPU throttling at 390); no code change for it.
